info.name: Flight Booking API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Flight Booking System.

**Base URL:** http://localhost:8000/api/v1

**Demo Accounts:**
- Customer: customer@example.com / Customer@123
- Staff: staff@example.com / Staff@123
- Admin: admin@example.com / Admin@123

**Quick Start:**
1. Run *Auth > Login (Customer)* — token is auto-saved
2. Run *Public > List Airports* to verify the server is up
3. Run *Flights & Search > Search Flights (One-way)* to get a flight
4. Copy a flight_id and fare_id into collection variables
5. Run *Booking Draft > Create Draft* then proceed through the booking flow
